description_en: Untags resources. This operation is the counterpart of TagResources
kebab_example: aliyun hbase un-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id example-string --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnTagResources

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to delete all tags. If TagKey is specified, tags are deleted only by TagKey. Valid values: true and false. If this parameter is set to true and TagKey is not specified, all tags are deleted
parameters.help_zh: 是否删除全部标签。如果传入了TagKey，则只按TagKey删除。为true/false，为true时切未传入TagKey时删除全部标签，
parameters.name: all

parameters.help_en: The ID of resource N to untag. The resource ID is the cluster ID. You can specify multiple resource IDs, such as ResourceId.2 and ResourceId.3. N is a positive integer
parameters.help_zh: 要删除的第N个资源Id，此处是为集群Id。如果有多个，可以传参数名为ResourceId.2、ResourceId.3等等。N为正整数
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The key of tag N to delete. You can specify multiple tag keys, such as TagKey.2 and TagKey.3. N is a positive integer
parameters.help_zh: 第N个要删除的标签的键，可传多个，TagKey.2、TagKey.3等待。N为正整数
parameters.name: tag_key
